headline.text: Truffle Line buffer tank drained after towel + metal found in chocolate path; *no additional FM* recovered during flush

summary: Three metal-related events across L3: bearing & fastener in Truffle Line chocolate gears (likely from supplier), towel wrapped in buffer valve, and ML4 depositor bolts removed from magnet tray. ML1 metal detector B100 malfunctioned for ~1 hour rejecting all product. All events contained; no finished-good escapes confirmed.

food_safety.title: ML1 metal detector sensor B100 rejecting all product
food_safety.summary: Sensor B100 malfunction caused line stop from 20:33 to 21:33; maintenance notified, sensor issue isolated, 186 lbs diverted to rework.
food_safety.status: Resolved — sensor repaired, line resumed production after maintenance clearance.

food_safety.title: Bearing and fastener found in Truffle Line chocolate gears
food_safety.summary: Maintenance discovered bearing and unidentified fastener in riser pump gears during troubleshooting; likely origin Classen chocolate supply based on equipment inspection.
food_safety.status: Resolved — buffer tank fully drained with inline screens, flushed with oil, permanent inline screen installed to prevent future FM from reaching pump.

food_safety.title: Towel found wrapped around Truffle Line buffer tank valve
food_safety.summary: Riser pump failure investigation revealed towel stuck in valve preventing rotation; tank drained through screened transfer, no additional FM found during drainage or oil flush.
food_safety.status: Resolved — system emptied, flushed, inline screen added, all temporary equipment ATP-tested before use.

food_safety.title: Chain lube oil found on ML3 splice box rollers
food_safety.summary: Operator noticed oil from splice box; investigation found chain lube oil had been used to clean rollers instead of food-grade lubricant, residue cleaned.
food_safety.status: Resolved — oil residue cleaned, QA approved line restart at 07:58.

food_safety.title: ML4 depositor 4 bolts removed from magnet tray
food_safety.summary: Maintenance removed bolts from depositor 4 magnet tray during shift; bolts had been visible at start of 3rd shift, removed and secured at 23:40.
food_safety.status: Resolved — bolts removed and secured, production resumed.

quality.title: Wrong case boxes used on S3 — previous shift + 2 current-shift pallets
quality.summary: Label verification at 23:59 discovered wrong boxes on all previous shift output plus 2 pallets from 3rd shift; rework initiated before next order.
quality.status: Open — rework underway, as much as possible completed before changeover.

quality.title: ML4 product bad bottoms — holes, exposed cream
quality.summary: Three bars with out-of-spec bottom appearance removed from south side at 08:42; root cause vibration rail buildup after depositor 4, cleaned and chocolate deposit increased.
quality.status: Resolved — QA monitored at demold through restart, appearance stable after adjustments, no further defects observed.

quality.title: S2 pallet wrap plastic too thick, poor adhesion on ~3 pallets
quality.summary: Warehouse flagged that new pallet-wrap plastic is thicker than usual and not adhering properly; wrapping team reports increasing tension would bend trays, 3 pallets reworked.
quality.status: Open — rework completed on affected pallets, next shift instructed to monitor wrapping quality.

sanitation.title: Dirty funnel stored in S1 Matrix cabinet
sanitation.summary: Victor found dirty funnel inside Matrix equipment cabinet during 1st shift; operators reminded that tools must be cleaned before storage.
sanitation.status: Resolved — funnel removed for cleaning, Matrix operators re-trained on tool storage standards.

opportunities.text: Consider lot-code verification at S3 case setup or first-pallet check — today's wrong-box error carried over from previous shift suggests setup verification gap.
Consider supplier audit or receiving inspection protocol for Classen chocolate — today's bearing and fastener in Truffle Line gears suggest upstream FM risk.
Review tool and towel accountability at Truffle Line — today's towel in buffer valve indicates gap in accountability for cleaning materials in production zones.
Add metal detector function verification to ML1 startup checklist — today's B100 sensor malfunction went undetected until production run, causing 186 lbs rework.
